svg.title: C17: fold timing of the three convolution engines
svg.text: Figure 1 - Fold timing of the three convolution engines (T = 4)
One PIPELINE II=1 loop per engine; DSP 576 + 256 + 200 = 1,032
step 0: read 1 transformed window (9 x 16 x 12 bit)
step 15: write 1 tile: 2x2 pixels x 64 channels
4 lanes x 9 sub-blocks x 16 taps = 576 DSP (12 b x 14 b)
tile is a shift register: shifts left by 4 channels per cycle, channels 0..63 in order after 16 cycles
step 0: read 1 pixel (64 channels x 10 bit)
4 lanes x 64 ic = 256 DSP, each DSP computes 2 output channels (27 b x 10 b)
result is a shift register: shifts left by 8 channels per cycle, channels 0..31 in order after 4 cycles
step 0: read 1 window (5x5 x 32 channels, two halves of 400 x 10 bit)
step 3: write 1 pixel: 1 channel, no ReLU
8 ic x 25 taps = 200 DSP (10 b x 10 b), then a 256-input, 8-level adder tree
sum register: starts from the bias at step 0, then adds this cycle's 200 products
